content.title: PlayStation Plus Extra & Premium Games - March 2026
content.text: PlayStation Plus Extra & Premium tiers get loads of great new games in the Game Catalogue this March. The PlayStation Plus game list includes EA Sports Madden NFL 26, Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, Persona 5 Royal, Blasphemous 2, Metal Eden, Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria, Astroneer, and for the Classics Catalogue, Tekken 5 Dark Resurrection. Which PlayStation Plus Extra & Premium March game are you most excited for? Let us know in the comments what you make of this month’s Game Catalogue line-up! These are your games for PlayStation Plus March 2026, available to download on PS4 and PS5 from March 17th for all PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium members. Not a member yet?
